identity.description:
Resume a stopped eval run, and plan one D4b baseline

Make the eval resumable, and plan one D4b baseline at the end.

A baseline at two repeats does not fit in one five-hour plan window, the eval and the CI reviewer use the same plan login, and a stopped eval run lost every result. This PR fixes the last point and changes the D4b plan.

## What changes

- Each finished repeat writes `<out>/<case>/<repeat>/result.json`: the `RepeatMetrics`, the case name and head, the repeat number, the tool version and the options that change a result (tier, judge model, extras, raw judge). A temp file and a rename write it, so a kill leaves no half file.
- `pr-review eval --resume` reads those files before the first model call. A repeat with a good result is reused: no clone and no model call. A failed, missing or malformed result, one for another case head, or one scored against another `golden.json` (a fingerprint in the file) runs again, and `--resume` clears its old output first. A result that would be reused but has another tool version or other options stops the command with exit 2, so one report never mixes two configurations. A run without `--resume` keeps the old records. Reused results go through the report, the gate and `--write-baseline` like fresh ones. Stderr says how many repeats were reused.
- README: a "Resume a run" section and the `--resume` flag.
- TICKETS.md, D4b: no revision moves the pin or writes a baseline. One final baseline PR moves the pin one time and writes the baseline at two repeats, with `--resume`.
- Version 0.8.0 for the new flag (after 0.7.0 of PR #45).

## Verification

- New tests in `test/eval-cli.test.ts`: a run that fails on the third case, then `--resume` on the same `--out`, makes model calls only for that case, and the aggregate equals that of one uninterrupted run; a reused repeat makes no call; a failed result runs again; another tool version gives exit 2; without `--resume` every repeat runs.
- `npm test` (1382 tests, on main after PR #45), `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` and `scripts/check-version-bump.sh` pass.

triage.summary: Adds a `--resume` flag to `pr-review eval`. Each finished repeat now writes an atomic `result.json` with its metrics, the case head, a golden fingerprint, the tool version and the options. With `--resume`, a repeat is reused when its result matches. A repeat that failed, is invalid or is stale runs again, and its old output is cleared first. If a result would be reused but the tool version or options differ, the run exits 2. The change also adds tests, README docs, a TICKETS.md update and a version bump to 0.8.0.
